performance_requirement.description: Each candidate system must achieve at least 80% of the reference system performance on every benchmark in the workload mix. Systems that cannot run a benchmark (e.g., due to missing hardware) are considered to fail that benchmark.

required_sections.cleaned_performance: For each system and benchmark: the representative execution time in seconds after handling data quality issues, along with counts of valid trials used and trials excluded.
required_sections.speedups: For each system and benchmark: performance ratio relative to the reference system (reference_time / system_time). Higher values indicate better performance.
required_sections.composite_scores: For each system: a single aggregate performance score derived from individual benchmark speedups weighted by workload priorities.
required_sections.feasibility: For each system: assessment of whether it satisfies all procurement constraints (budget, power, performance threshold).
required_sections.pareto_optimal: List of system names forming the Pareto-optimal front among feasible candidates, considering both total cost and composite performance.
required_sections.cost_efficiency: For each feasible system: a cost-performance metric (composite score divided by total system cost in millions of USD).
required_sections.ranking: Ordered list of feasible system names from highest to lowest cost-efficiency.
required_sections.recommendation: Name of the single recommended system (highest cost-efficiency among feasible Pareto-optimal candidates).
